name: EPIC 206055949
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.1 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206055949 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.140796 (16th-84th percentiles 6.955206-7.377695), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206055949 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.895218 (16th-84th percentiles 0.838497-0.968442), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206055949: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4682.888 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206055949 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1913.828125 (16th-84th percentiles 1869.121094-1964.824219), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.12 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,914 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.90 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,683 K at its surface.
